question: Atoms of which of the following elements has more than one electron in its outermost shell?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Beryllium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atoms** of **Beryllium** have **two electrons** in the **outermost shell**.
 
• Beryllium is an **alkaline earth metal** element.
 
• **Beryllium **
 
 
• Atomic no**: 4**
 
• Formula**: Be**
 
• Electronic Configuration**: 1s²2s²**
 
 
 
• The **outermost shell** of an **atom **is called the **valence shell**.
 
• **Electrons **in the **outer shell** help us determine the **reactivity of the element**.
 
• The **distribution **of **electrons **in **energy shells** is termed **Electronic Configuration**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b63a68861ffe41e4a63bd748acca75c58fbcfe0e92b6c84d939d667073b9a7ee.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Lithium**
 
 
 
• Is an **Alkali Metal**
 
• Formula: **Li**
 
• Atomic no.: **3**
 
• Electronic Configuration: **1s²2s¹**
 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db90fa9d67fce0316f81dc732ecbe073f4c15c1f93827a3a58fc7662c215468b.png] 
 
 

 **Hydrogen**
 
 
 
• **Gaseous **element
 
• Formula: **H**
 
• Atomic no.: **1**

 **Sodium**
